messages.content:
Dear all,

the official deadline for the technical report has passed. As we understand, that submitting to a scientific conference is not possible for everyone, we wanted to encourage all teams that did not submit a final report, to publish their approach on arXiv (http://arxiv.org/). If you need help with this, please do not hesitate to reach out to me.

Thanks, Marius
